details: Civil Citation C-2024-88: Failure to provide mandatory 24-hour statutory notification for 8.5 bbl crude release on 2024-04-15 (reported on day 4).
Spill incident report submitted at 14:20 (5 hours after drone discovery). Remedial boom deployed. Audit confirmed timely compliance.
State inspector visited site following initial drone report. Verified field correction: ponding was non-hydrocarbon rainwater runoff. Incident record closed with zero citation.
Subsurface workover permit approved for ESP motor retrieval and electrical diagnostics.
